welcome.tagline: Find parks, post clips, meet the locals.
welcome.inviteOnly: New here? Grindylocks is invite only for now. Ask a skater you know to send you an invite link.

email.title: Sign in with email
email.body: We'll email you a code. No password needed.
email.label: Email
email.invalid: That doesn't look like an email address.
email.notMember: There's no account for that email yet. Grindylocks is invite only for now, so ask a skater you know for an invite link.
email.rateLimited: Too many codes in a short time. Wait a minute and try again.

code.title: Check your email
code.body: We sent a code to {{email}}. Enter it below.
code.label: Code
code.wrong: That code is wrong or has expired. Check it, or send a new one.

invite.title: Enter your invite
invite.body: Type the code from the invite a skater sent you. It looks like ABCD-2345.
invite.label: Invite code
invite.invalid: That invite doesn't work. It may have expired, been used or been cancelled. Ask for a new one.
invite.validFor: Invite {{code}} works once and expires 7 days after it was made.
invite.otherWays: Apple and Google sign-in are coming soon.

age.title: Are you 16 or older?
age.body: Grindylocks is for skaters 16 and up. We only save that you said yes, never your birthday.
age.tooYoungBody: Grindylocks is for skaters 16 and older for now. We'll still be here.

username.title: Who's rolling?
username.label: Username
username.invalid: Use 2–30 letters, numbers, dots or underscores.

city.title: Where do you skate?
city.body: Your city sets up your feed and who to follow. Only signed-in members see it.
city.announceBody: Let skaters in {{city}} know someone new joined. Turn it off to join quietly.

regulars.title: Heads up: you're a regular
regulars.body: Post at a park more than 5 times, or make it your home park, and you show up in its regulars list. That tells other members where you skate.
regulars.point1: Only signed-in members see regulars lists.
regulars.point2: Private accounts never appear in them.
regulars.point3: You can hide yourself any time in settings.

page.noSkating: Leave these blank if you don't skate. You can add them later in Edit profile.
page.cityFromShop: We filled in {{name}}'s city. Change it if you live somewhere else. Only signed-in members see it.

home.title: Home
home.caughtUp: You're caught up on people you follow
home.emptyBody: Follow skaters you know, or be the first to post from your city.
home.loadError: Couldn't load the feed. Check your connection.

errors.network: Couldn't reach Grindylocks. Check your connection and try again.

post.limits: Photos and clips up to 60 s each
post.rejectedTooLong_one: {{count}} clip is over 60 seconds. Trim it in your Photos app first.
post.rejectedTooLong_other: {{count}} clips are over 60 seconds. Trim them in your Photos app first.
post.rejectedTooBig_one: {{count}} clip is too big to upload (over 200 MB). Export it at 1080p and try again.
post.rejectedTooBig_other: {{count}} clips are too big to upload (over 200 MB). Export them at 1080p and try again.
post.rejectedUnsupported_one: {{count}} file isn't a photo or clip Grindylocks can use (JPEG, PNG, HEIC, MOV or MP4).
post.rejectedUnsupported_other: {{count}} files aren't photos or clips Grindylocks can use (JPEG, PNG, HEIC, MOV or MP4).
post.backgroundNote: Uploads keep going in the background, even on bad signal.
post.preparing: Getting your photos and clips ready…
post.tapToPreview: Tap a slide to see it
post.limitsShort: Up to 10 · clips up to 60 s
post.mentionHint: People you mention are notified when you post.

uploads.errorTooLong: A clip is over 60 seconds, so it was turned down.
uploads.errorVideoNotConfigured: Clip uploads aren't switched on yet.
uploads.errorRejected: The upload didn't go through. Try again, or delete the post.
uploads.discardBody: It hasn't been posted yet. This removes it and its uploads.

viewer.title: Post
viewer.videoUnavailable: Clips can't play yet: video playback isn't set up.

map.noParksHere: No parks on this part of the map yet.
map.loadError: Couldn't load parks. Check your connection.

filters.title: Filters
filters.whoCanSkateHint: Parks that allow any you pick.
filters.settingHint: Parks with indoor and outdoor sections show for either.
filters.openNowHint: Parks and shops, each on its own clock
filters.litHint: Parks only. Lights are unknown for some parks, so they're hidden
filters.showShopsHint: Skate shops you can walk into

edge.label: {{park}}, {{distance}} away, off the map
edge.hint: Moves the map to this park

search.hint: Search by city, park name or what locals call it.

park.savedLabel: {{park}} is saved to want to skate. Tap to remove it.
park.noRegulars: No regulars yet. Skaters show up here once they've posted here a few times or made it their home park.
park.nothingPostedBody: Skated {{park}}? Tag it in your next post and it shows up here.

notifications.title: Notifications
notifications.empty: Nothing yet. Comments, tags, follow requests and invites will show up here.
notifications.commentMany_one: {{a}}, {{b}} and {{count}} other commented on your post
notifications.commentMany_other: {{a}}, {{b}} and {{count}} others commented on your post
notifications.someoneNew: {{a}} just joined Grindylocks in {{metro}}. Say hi!
notifications.visitingPark: {{a}} is visiting {{metro}} and will be at {{park}}
notifications.parkFixLive: Your fix to {{park}} is live. Thanks.
notifications.postRemoved: Your post was taken down after a review.
notifications.commentRemoved: Your comment was removed after a review.
notifications.roleVacatedPark: {{a}}'s {{role}} role at {{park}} ended. Pick someone new.
notifications.meetupGoingMany_one: {{a}} and {{count}} other are going to {{when}} at {{park}}
notifications.meetupGoingMany_other: {{a}} and {{count}} others are going to {{when}} at {{park}}

page.teamInvite: {{name}} invited you to join its team as {{role}}
page.ownership: {{a}} wants to make you the owner of {{name}}
page.claimInvite: {{name}} invited you to manage its page
page.ownershipNote: You'd handle the team and could remove managers. If you decline, Grindylocks picks the new owner.
page.inviteClosed: This invite isn't open any more.
page.inviteSuspended: You can't join a page's team while your account is suspended.
page.claimApproved: Your claim for {{name}} was approved. Add a logo to make the page official.
page.claimTaken: Someone else from {{name}} now runs its page
page.tryAgain: You can try again with another proof.
page.joinedNote: You followed their page before it was official.
page.handedOver: {{a}} is now the owner of {{name}}. You're a manager.

messages.title: Messages
messages.heading: Direct messages are on the way
messages.body: Until then, say hi in the comments, tag people in your posts, or find skaters through a park's regulars.

find.title: Search
find.hint: Find skaters by username, or parks by name or what locals call them.
find.suggestTitle: Can't find a brand or shop?

profile.privateBody: This account is private. Only people they've accepted as followers see their posts.
profile.emptyPostsOwn: Nothing posted yet. Your posts show up here.
profile.emptyTaggedOwn: Posts you're tagged in will show up here.
profile.emptyTagged: Posts {{username}} is tagged in will show up here.
profile.emptyFilmedOwn: Clips you filmed will show up here.
profile.emptyFilmed: Clips {{username}} filmed will show up here.
profile.emptySaved: Parks you save to want to skate show up here. Only you can see them.

editProfile.title: Edit profile
editProfile.usernameNote: You can change it once every 30 days. Your old name stays reserved for you for 14 days. Tags and mentions update on their own.
editProfile.usernameLocked: You changed your username recently. You can change it again on {{date}}.
editProfile.usernameCooldown: You can only change your username once every 30 days.
editProfile.bioPlaceholder: Where you skate, what you ride, who you film
editProfile.homeNote: Moving cities? You'll be asked whether to say hi to skaters in your new city. Your old posts stay where they were filmed.
editProfile.meetupNote: Shows a tag on your profile

sayHi.title: Welcome to {{city}}
sayHi.body: Your home city is updated. Your old posts stay where they were filmed.

settings.title: Settings
settings.appleGoogleBody: Link them to sign in without a code
settings.privateBody: New followers need your OK. You're never shown as a regular.
settings.regularsBody: At your home park and parks you post at a lot
settings.languageBody: Follows your phone. Change it for Grindylocks in your phone's settings.
settings.dataCopy: Get a copy of my data
settings.goingPrivatelyBody: Only the hosts see your name on going lists. You can change it for each meetup.

credits.osmBody: Park locations come from OpenStreetMap, available under the Open Database License.

changeEmail.title: Change email
changeEmail.body: You sign in with {{email}} now. We'll send a code to the new address to check it's yours.
changeEmail.label: New email
changeEmail.taken: Another account already uses that email.
changeEmail.codeCurrent: One more step: we also sent a code to your current address, {{email}}. Enter it below.
changeEmail.doneBody: You'll sign in with {{email}} from now on.

parkPhotos.full: This park already has {{max}} photos. Remove one to add another.
parkPhotos.unsupported: Some of those couldn't be added. Park photos can be JPEG, PNG or HEIC.
parkPhotos.noneYet: This park has no photos yet
parkPhotos.tipWide: Two or three wide, landscape shots of the whole park work best.
parkPhotos.tipPeople: Leave people out, or keep them too small to recognise. Riding shots go in posts.
parkPhotos.tipRights: Only add photos you took or have permission to use.
parkPhotos.photographerHint: Shown as "Photo by …" in the gallery.
parkPhotos.licenseHint: "own" for your photos, "permission" when the park said yes, or the license name, like CC BY-SA 4.0.
parkPhotos.failed: That didn't upload. Check your connection and try again.
parkPhotos.partFailed: {{done}} of {{count}} added. The rest didn't upload; try again.
parkPhotos.swipeHint: Swipe for more. Skating shots live in posts;
parkPhotos.removeBody: It comes out of the gallery for everyone.
parkPhotos.removeFailed: Couldn't remove the photo. Try again.
parkPhotos.reorderFailed: Couldn't move the photo. Try again.

invites.title: Invites
invites.body: Each link works once and expires after 7 days. If it's cancelled or expires unused, you get the invite back. Need more? Ask your city or park admin.
invites.noneLeftBody: Ask your city or park admin if you need more.
invites.cancelBody: {{code}} will stop working and you'll get the invite back.

follow.unfollowPrivateBody: Their account is private, so you'd have to ask again to see their posts.

block.title: Block {{username}}?
block.body: You won't see each other's profiles, posts or comments, and neither of you will follow the other. They aren't told. You can unblock them in Settings.
block.unblockBody: You'll see each other again. Follows the block ended don't come back; either of you can follow again.
block.listBody: People you've blocked can't see your profile, posts or comments, and you don't see theirs.

tagging.title: Tag it
tagging.parkEverySlide: Park for every slide · tap to change
tagging.parkEncourage: Tag the park so it shows up on its page
tagging.noParkLine: Garage sessions, street spots, anywhere else
tagging.optional: Tags are optional. Each slide can have its own.
tagging.noObstacles: No obstacles listed at this park yet.
tagging.notListed: Not listed? Pick a type or suggest it
tagging.typeBody: Pick the kind of obstacle, or suggest it so it's added to the park. Suggestions are checked before others see them.
tagging.typeBodyNoPark: Without a park, pick the kind of obstacle.
tagging.suggestTitle: Or suggest it for this park
tagging.suggestHint: For example "the long kinked rail by the bowl". Pick its type above.
tagging.filmerOff: {{username}} is the filmer. Tag as skating instead
tagging.personHint: Type at least two letters of their username.
tagging.editLater: You can edit the caption and tags after posting.
tagging.noParkLineMetro: Garage, driveway, street. Shows under {{metro}}, not on a park page.
tagging.noParkLineHome: Garage, driveway, street. Shows under your home city, not on a park page.
tagging.justTypeLine: Rail, ledge, bowl… without naming one
tagging.suggestRowLine: Tags your clip now; others see it once it's approved
tagging.suggestNote: Your clip is tagged with it right away. Everyone else sees the tag once a contributor at this park approves it.
tagging.parkLineEdit: Park · every slide. Changing it clears obstacle tags from this park.

postCard.deleteBody: It's removed from your profile, the park and every feed.
postCard.removeMeBody: Your tag and any filmer credit are removed, so it leaves your Tagged and Filmed tabs. The post stays up.

editPost.title: Edit post
editPost.slides: Slides · media can't change after posting
editPost.footnote: Saved changes show “edited” on the post. People you add are notified; people you take off aren't.
editPost.mentionNote: Only people you add now are notified. People already mentioned aren't notified again, and people you remove aren't told.

obstacle.empty: Nothing tagged here yet. Tag this obstacle in a post and it shows up here.

comments.title: Comments
comments.deleteBody: It can't be brought back. Replies to it stay up.

commentAs.title: Comment as
commentAs.toggleHint: Choose whether to comment as you or as a page you're on
commentAs.where: {{name}} can comment on its own posts and posts that mention it.
commentAs.notHere: {{name}} can't comment on this post any more.

push.rowBody: Comments, tags, filmer credit and more
push.title: Push notifications
push.intro: Everything still shows under the bell on your feed. These switches only decide what buzzes your phone.
push.commentsBody: On your posts, and replies to your comments
push.mentionsBody: When someone @mentions you in a comment or caption
push.tagsBody: When someone tags you in a post
push.filmerBody: When someone credits you for filming
push.invitesBody: When someone joins with your invite
push.someoneNewBody: When a skater in {{metro}} says hi or is visiting
push.someoneNewBodyNoCity: When a skater in your city says hi or is visiting
push.likes: Likes never notify you. Nobody sees like counts on Grindylocks, including you.
push.offBody: Turn them on in your phone's settings to get pushes. The bell still shows everything.
push.askBody: Get a buzz when someone comments, tags you or says hi nearby.
push.meetupsBody: Changes, cancellations and reminders for meetups you're going to
push.fixesBody: When your park fix, or a brand or product you suggested, goes live
push.teamsClaimsBody: Team invites, role changes, ownership and your claim decisions
push.pagesJoiningBody: Once per page, when a brand or shop you follow takes over its page
push.inboxNote: Off by default, and only for you: each person on the team picks their own.

report.spamBody: Ads, scams or the same thing posted over and over
report.whoPost: @{{username}} isn't told who reported it. A park or city admin reviews it; after 3 reports a post hides until they do.
report.whoComment: @{{username}} isn't told who reported it. A park or city admin reviews it.
report.whoPerson: @{{username}} isn't told who reported them. Rachel reviews it.
report.sentPark: An admin for {{park}} will take a look. You won't hear back unless they need you.
report.sentAdmin: An admin will take a look. You won't hear back unless they need you.
report.sentOwner: Rachel will take a look. You won't hear back unless she needs you.
report.blockTooBody: You won't see each other's posts, comments or profiles. They aren't told.
report.whoMeetup: @{{username}} isn't told who reported it. This park's admins review it.
report.impersonation: Pretending to be a brand or shop
report.noPageFound: No brand or shop called that.
report.whoImpersonation: @{{username}} isn't told who reported it. Rachel checks it against {{page}}'s page.

reported.wrong_park_one: Reported {{count}} time as not at this park
reported.wrong_park_other: Reported {{count}} times as not at this park
reported.involves_minor_one: Reported {{count}} time as involving someone under 16
reported.involves_minor_other: Reported {{count}} times as involving someone under 16
reported.impersonation_one: Reported {{count}} time as pretending to be a brand or shop
reported.impersonation_other: Reported {{count}} times as pretending to be a brand or shop
reported.our_page_one: Reported {{count}} time by someone who says it's their brand or shop
reported.our_page_other: Reported {{count}} times by people who say it's their brand or shop

moderation.hiddenBody: Hidden for everyone until you decide.
moderation.webAdmin: Warnings, suspensions and bans are on the web admin.
moderation.keepHiddenTitle: Keep @{{username}}'s post hidden? They're told it was taken down after a review.
moderation.dismissTitle: Dismiss the reports? The post shows for everyone again, and nobody is told.

restriction.suspendedBody: You can look around, but can't post, comment, like or follow until then.
restriction.bannedBody: You can look around, but can't post, comment, like or follow.

help.title: Help
help.intro: Grindylocks is a small beta, and a real person reads every email.
help.emailBody: Opens your mail app. Bugs, park mistakes, questions, anything.

reporting.title: Reporting a post, comment or person
reporting.body: Tap ··· and Report. A park or city admin reviews it; harassment and anything involving someone under 16 go straight to Rachel. They aren't told who reported them.

parkFix.title: Fixing a park's details
parkFix.body: On the park page, tap ··· and Report something wrong, or Suggest a fix at the bottom. Pick what's wrong and add the right value, a note or a photo of the sign. A park admin checks it before anything changes, and we'll let you know when your fix goes live.

blocking.title: Blocking someone
blocking.body: Tap ··· on their profile or one of their posts and pick Block. You won't see each other's profiles, posts or comments, and neither of you follows the other. They aren't told. You can unblock them in Settings, under Blocked accounts.

whereISkate.title: Who sees where I skate
whereISkate.body: A post tagged at a park shows on that park's page. Regulars lists show people whose home park it is or who post there a lot; turn off "Show me in regulars lists" in Settings to leave them. Private accounts never appear in regulars lists.

dataCopy.body: We'll email everything Grindylocks keeps about you to {{email}}, as one file you can open in any text editor:

included.profile: Your profile, posts, captions and comments
included.social: Likes, follows, blocks and saved parks
included.credits: Tags, filmer credits and park photos
included.reports: Reports you sent and any moderation notices

dataCopy.note: Photos and clips are listed by link, not attached. One copy a day.
dataCopy.onceADay: You can ask for one copy a day. Try again tomorrow.
dataCopy.notSwitchedOn: Data exports aren't switched on yet.

deleteAccount.title: Delete your account
deleteAccount.body: This can't be undone. Here's what happens:
deleteAccount.profile: Your profile, follows and saved parks are deleted.
deleteAccount.tags: Where you're tagged or credited as filmer on other people's posts, it shows "deleted user".
deleteAccount.roleAt: Your role as {{role}} at {{place}} ends now. {{next}}
deleteAccount.nextParkAdmin: Your park admin will pick someone new.
deleteAccount.nextCityAdmin: Your city admin will pick someone new.
deleteAccount.invites_one: Your {{count}} unused invite link stops working. People you invited keep their accounts.
deleteAccount.invites_other: Your {{count}} unused invite links stop working. People you invited keep their accounts.
deleteAccount.keepBody: They stay on park and obstacle pages as "deleted user", so the clips people filmed with you aren't lost.
deleteAccount.removeBody: Your posts and park photos are removed for everyone.
deleteAccount.sendCode: Send me a code to confirm
deleteAccount.sendCodeBody: We'll email a code to {{email}}. Enter it on the next screen to delete your account.
deleteAccount.codeBodyKeep: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Entering it deletes your account and leaves your posts up as "deleted user".
deleteAccount.codeBodyRemove: We sent a 6-digit code to {{email}}. Entering it deletes your account and your posts.
deleteAccount.codeExpired: That code has run out. Send a new code and enter it to delete your account.

owner.onlyOne: {{kind}} · you're the only one on the team
owner.handOver: Hand it to someone on the team before you go. They have to accept. If they decline, you can pick someone else.
owner.availableOnce: Available once {{name}} has a new owner.
owner.soloUnofficial: The page goes back to UNOFFICIAL. Its logo and OFFICIAL stamp go, and nobody can post as it.
owner.soloPosts: Its posts stay up, read-only. They belong to the page, not to you.
owner.soloFollowers: Followers stay. Someone from the business can claim it again later.
owner.soloTick: I understand {{name}} goes back to Unofficial
owner.soloElse: Rather keep it running? Invite someone to the team and hand it over first.
owner.pagePosts: Posts and comments you made as {{name}} stay up. They belong to the page; inside the team they show "deleted user".

parkReport.title: What's wrong?
parkReport.addPhoto: Add a photo of the sign
parkReport.footnote: A park admin checks it before anything changes. We'll let you know when your fix goes live.
parkReport.sentBody: A park admin will check it. We'll let you know when your fix goes live.

errors.say_what_is_wrong: Suggest the right value, add a note or add a photo, so the admins know what to fix.
errors.photo_not_uploaded: The photo didn't upload. Try again, or send it without the photo.
errors.too_many_reports: That's a lot of reports in an hour. Try again a bit later.
errors.generic: Couldn't send it. Check your connection and try again.

framing.hintVertical: Drag up or down to choose what the feed shows
framing.hintHorizontal: Drag left or right to choose what the feed shows
framing.centerLabel: Put the frame back in the middle
framing.note: The feed shows the pink frame. The whole photo or clip is one tap away.
framing.title: Frame

hereNow.title: Here now
hereNow.countNote: Checked in in the last 3 hours
hereNow.nobody: Nobody you follow is checked in here.
hereNow.checkedOnce: Your location was checked once. It isn't tracked after this.
hereNow.awayBody: You need to be at the park to check in. You're about {{distance}} away.
hereNow.awayNoDistance: You need to be at the park to check in.
hereNow.locationOffBody: Checking in uses your location once to confirm you're at the park.
hereNow.noFixBody: Try again in a moment, outside if you can.
hereNow.friendsNote: People you follow who follow you back
hereNow.lasts: Until {{time}}, or until you tap I left. Nothing is kept afterwards.
hereNow.lastsShort: For 3 hours, or until you tap I left. Nothing is kept afterwards.
hereNow.countRule: Everyone else sees a count, once 3 or more skaters are here.
hereNow.seenByFollowers: Followers can see where you are
hereNow.seenByFriends: Friends can see where you are
hereNow.noParkNear: You're not at a park we know
hereNow.noParkNearBody: Check-ins are for parks on Grindylocks. If this one is missing, suggest it from Search.

meetup.hostsOnlyList: Only hosts see who went, for a week after it ends.
meetup.noticeTitle: People who can see this meetup can see you're going.
meetup.noticeBody: Private accounts are only named to their followers. Turn on Going privately to show just the hosts.
meetup.goingPrivatelyBody: Only the hosts see your name. Everyone else sees the count.
meetup.goingFootnote: Going is just for this date. Your default is in Settings › Privacy.
meetup.noComments: No comments yet. Ask the hosts anything.
meetup.coHostBody: Co-hosts can edit, cancel dates and remove people from Going. You'll be listed once you accept.
meetup.hiddenBody: Only its hosts and this park's admins can see this date.
meetup.removeBody: They aren't told. They can't see who else is going once they're off the list.

meetupCompose.parkTimeNote: Times are on the park's clock. That's {{time}} for you.
meetupCompose.repeatsFirst: Pick a park and a start time first.
meetupCompose.title: Title
meetupCompose.footer: Shows on Home for your followers. Nobody gets a notification.
meetupCompose.footerFollowers: Only your followers and your co-hosts' followers see it. Nobody gets a notification.
meetupCompose.failedBody: Check the time hasn't passed and try again.
meetupCompose.disciplinesHint: Shown as chips on the meetup. Anyone can still come.
meetupCompose.titleHint: Optional. Without one, your line is the headline.
meetupCompose.seasonsHint: Each date's park comes from its season
meetupCompose.repeatsNote: Dates are added 12 weeks ahead. Each date has its own going list, so one can be moved or rained out without touching the rest.
meetupCompose.coHostHint: Co-hosts accept before they're listed. Up to 10.

meetupCard.emptyOwn: Meetups you host or co-host show here.

fromMeetup.note: You were going to {{meetup}} here. Linking puts this post on the meetup.
fromMeetup.linkedNote: This post shows on {{meetup}}. Tap to remove it.

meetupMenu.title: Meetup
meetupMenu.cancelDetail: Stays on the park page, crossed out
meetupMenu.deleteDetail: Removes it completely. Only until someone else is going or it starts.
meetupMenu.hideDetail: Only its hosts and park admins will see it
meetupMenu.unhideDetail: Everyone who could see it will again
meetupMenu.deleteBody: It's removed completely, as if you never posted it. Use this for mistakes, like the wrong park or day.
meetupMenu.deleteNote: Once someone else says they're going, or it starts, you can only cancel it.
meetupMenu.deleteFailedBody: Someone may have just said they're going. You can still cancel it.
meetupMenu.hideBody: Only its hosts and this park's admins will see it. The hosts are told it was hidden.

meetupCancel.title: Cancel meetup
meetupCancel.notePlaceholder: Bowl's flooded. See you next week
meetupCancel.footnote_one: The {{count}} person going gets a push. It stays on the park page, crossed out, with your reason.
meetupCancel.footnote_other: The {{count}} people going get a push. It stays on the park page, crossed out, with your reason.
meetupCancel.footnoteNobody: It stays on the park page, crossed out, with your reason.

coHosts.body: Co-hosts can edit, cancel dates and remove people from Going. They accept before they're listed.
coHosts.removeBody: They stop co-hosting this meetup. They aren't told.
coHosts.inviteFailed: Couldn't send the invites. A meetup can have up to 10 co-hosts.

meetupEdit.title: Edit meetup
meetupEdit.footer: People going hear about changes to the day, time or park.
meetupEdit.seasonsPark: This meetup's park comes from its seasons, so change the park for this date only.

page.unofficialBrand: Unofficial, not managed by this brand
page.unofficialShop: Unofficial, not managed by this shop
page.nameOnly: Not managed by this brand. Listed so skaters' gear stays linked.
page.retiredIn: {{name}} stopped making gear in {{year}}. This page stays up as an archive, so skaters can still find and talk about its gear.
page.retiredAround: {{name}} stopped making gear around {{year}}. This page stays up as an archive, so skaters can still find and talk about its gear.
page.retired: {{name}} doesn't make gear any more. This page stays up as an archive, so skaters can still find and talk about its gear.
page.closedIn: This shop closed in {{date}}. Its page stays up as an archive, with its posts.
page.followHint: Follow to hear when {{name}} joins Grindylocks.
page.blocked: You blocked {{name}}. Its posts and meetups are hidden for you.
page.missing: There's no brand or shop page here.

menu.muteBody: Hide their posts from Home. You still follow them, and they aren't told.
menu.unmuteBody: Their posts show in Home again.
menu.blockBody: Unfollows, hides their posts and meetups everywhere, and stops them commenting on yours. They aren't told.
menu.unblockBody: Their posts and meetups can show again. You won't follow them unless you choose to.

report.label: Page @{{handle}}
report.title: Report this page
report.ourPage: This is our brand or shop
report.reachHint: Your role and an email on the brand's own domain helps
report.who: Reports about a page go straight to Rachel. {{name}}'s team isn't told who reported it.
report.blockTooBody: Its posts and meetups disappear for you, and it can't comment on yours. It isn't told.

suggest.title: Suggest a brand or shop
suggest.name: Name
suggest.note: Rachel checks every suggestion. Once it's added, it shows as an unofficial page and you'll get a notification.
suggest.sentBody: You'll get a notification once it's live.
suggest.tooMany: That's a lot of suggestions for one day. Try again tomorrow.

mention.heading: Pages

claim.title: Claim this page
claim.intro: Run {{name}}'s page on Grindylocks: post as {{name}}, keep its products right and build a team. We check every claim by hand.
claim.workEmailBody: An address at {{name}}. We send it a code.
claim.noMatch: Doesn't match {{name}}'s website. You can still send it; we'll look more closely.
claim.postCodeBody: We give you a short code to post on {{name}}'s Instagram or website.
claim.notePlaceholder: Who you are, who else runs {{name}}
claim.afterApproval: Once it's approved, you add {{name}}'s logo and the page becomes official.
claim.codeNote: The code only proves you can read this inbox. Your claim still goes to us to check.
claim.postBody: Put it in a post, story or bio on {{name}}'s Instagram, or anywhere on {{name}}'s website. Leave it up until we've checked.
claim.codeValid: This code works until {{date}} and only for this claim.
claim.wherePlaceholder: A link to the post or page
claim.whereNeeded: Add a link to where the code is, or will be.
claim.postLater: You can send your claim now and post the code later. We'll look once it's up.
claim.pendingEmail: Sent {{date}} with your work email. We'll tell you under the bell when it's decided.
claim.pendingPosted: Sent {{date}} with a posted code. We'll tell you under the bell when it's decided.
claim.withdrawBody: You can claim it again later.
claim.takenReason: Someone else from {{name}} now runs this page.
claim.logoBody: The page stays unofficial until it has one.

result.wrong_code: That code isn't right. Check the email and try again.
result.code_expired: That code has run out. Send a new one.
result.too_many_tries: Too many wrong codes. Send a new one.
result.wait: Wait a minute before sending another code.

error.claim_pending: You already have a claim waiting for this page.
error.too_many_claims: That's a lot of claims for one day. Try again tomorrow.
error.too_many_codes: We've sent this claim enough codes. Start again tomorrow, or post a code instead.
error.not_claimable: This page can't be claimed right now.
error.invalid_link: Add a link to where the code is, or will be.

pageLogo.title: Add {{name}}'s logo
pageLogo.body: The logo is how skaters know a page is really {{name}}. It turns the page official.
pageLogo.previewLabel: Preview of {{name}}'s header with the logo
pageLogo.preview: Preview: how {{name}}'s header looks once the logo is in.
pageLogo.hint: A square image works best, at least 400 px. You can change it any time.
pageLogo.skipNote: No logo to hand? Skip it and {{name}} stays

pageInvite.claimShop: Post as {{name}}, keep its hours right and plan meetups.
pageInvite.claimBrand: Post as {{name}}, keep its products right and plan meetups.
pageInvite.claimTeam: Build a team of managers and staff.
pageInvite.claimChecked: We've already checked it's you, so there's no claim to wait on. You'll add {{name}}'s logo at the end.
pageInvite.teamShop: Post and comment as {{name}}, host meetups and update hours.
pageInvite.teamBrand: Post and comment as {{name}} and host meetups.
pageInvite.teamOwnAccount: You also get your own free account. You don't have to skate.
pageInvite.claimFoot: Already on Grindylocks? Sign in with that email and {{name}} is added to your account. This invite works once and expires in {{days}} days.
pageInvite.teamFoot: Sent to {{email}}. Already on Grindylocks? Sign in and accept from your notifications. Expires in {{days}} days.
pageInvite.teamFootNoEmail: Already on Grindylocks? Sign in and accept from your notifications. Expires in {{days}} days.

errors.notFound: Nobody on Grindylocks has that username.
errors.tooMany: {{name}} has 10 invites waiting. Cancel one to send another.
errors.notAllowed: You can't do that on this page.
errors.suspended: They can't take over while their account is suspended.
errors.onTheTeam: They're on the team. Remove them first.

pageTeam.whoHint: Someone not on Grindylocks gets an email invite to join with this page. It doesn't use your own invites.
pageTeam.removeBody: They'll be told they were removed.
pageTeam.offerBody: They have to accept. You stay on the team as a manager. If they decline, you can offer it to someone else.
pageTeam.transferNobody: Invite someone to {{name}}'s team first, then hand it over.
pageTeam.transferNote: Only the owner can remove a manager or hand over the page. Keep at least two people on the team so {{name}} can't get locked out.
pageTeam.nudge: You're the only one on the team. Invite someone so {{name}} can't get locked out.
pageTeam.declined: {{username}} declined to take over. You can offer it to someone else.
pageTeam.blockedNote: They can't follow, mention or comment on {{name}}, and they aren't told. Grindylocks sees every block.

pageEdit.title: Edit page
pageEdit.notYours: Only the page's team can open this.
pageEdit.saveFailed: Couldn't save. Check your connection and try again.
pageEdit.logoNote: The page shows as official once it has a logo.
pageEdit.descriptionNote: People see their own language if you've added it, otherwise {{language}}.
pageEdit.mainNeeded: Write the description in {{language}}, the main language, first.
pageEdit.invalidLink: Check the links: each needs a dot and no spaces.
pageEdit.showPin: Show the pin on the map
pageEdit.showPinBody: Leave it off if the shop is run from home. The page shows the city instead.
pageEdit.staffNote: Everyone on the team can change hours and Closed for a while. Everything else is for managers and the owner.
pageEdit.staffOnly: Managers and the owner edit everything else on {{name}}.
pageEdit.closeNote: The page stays up as an archive with its posts. Only Rachel can open it again.
pageEdit.closeBody: It leaves the map, nobody can follow it, and the team can't post as it. Its posts and followers stay.
pageEdit.retireBrand: Mark {{name}} as no longer making gear
pageEdit.retireNote: The page becomes Retired: an archive with its posts and gear. Only Rachel can bring it back.
pageEdit.retireBody: Nobody can follow it, and the team can't post as it. Its posts, gear and followers stay.

closedSheet.title: Closed for a while
closedSheet.body: The page shows “Closed until …” with your note, and the usual hours greyed out.
closedSheet.noteNeeded: Add a note so people know why.

brands.none: Add the brands you carry. They show on your page and link to theirs.

pageInbox.caption: {{username}} mentioned {{name}} in a post
pageInbox.blockBody: They can't follow, mention or comment on {{name}}, and they aren't told. You can unblock them from Team.
pageInbox.followersNote: Only your team sees this number. Nobody sees who.
pageInbox.empty: When someone comments on {{name}}'s posts, replies to it or @mentions it, it shows up here.
pageInbox.pushBody: Just for you. Everyone on the team sets their own.

pageAddress.title: Address and pin
pageAddress.addressNote: Shown on your page as you write it.
pageAddress.find: Find this address on the map
pageAddress.notFound: Couldn't find that address. Move the map to put the pin on your door.
pageAddress.lookupNeedsLocation: Finding an address uses location services on this phone. Turn them on in Settings, or move the map yourself.
pageAddress.moveMap: Move the map until the pin is on your door.
pageAddress.findFirst: Find your address first, or zoom in and move the map.
pageAddress.mapLabel: Map with the shop pin in the middle. Move the map to move the pin.
pageAddress.mapLabelEmpty: Map. Find your address first, then move the map to place the pin.
pageAddress.pinNoteStorefront: The pin puts {{name}} on the map, and Directions go to it. Storefronts always show their pin.
pageAddress.pinNote: The pin puts {{name}} on the map, and Directions go to it.
pageAddress.pinNeeded: A storefront needs a pin. Find your address or move the map to place it.
pageAddress.tooLong: The address can be up to 200 characters.
pageAddress.cityNote: Your city decides Near you and your local admin. Moving to another city?

pageHours.title: Hours
pageHours.onCityTime: On {{city}} time. Everyone on the team can change hours.
pageHours.onShopTime: On the shop's own time. Everyone on the team can change hours.
pageHours.sameAllYearConfirm: Use the same hours all year?
pageHours.sameAllYearBody: The hours for {{dates}} stay, for the whole year. The other dates and their hours go.
pageHours.gapBody: Your page shows Closed for the season then. Change the dates if that's not right.
pageHours.overlap: Two sets of dates both cover {{date}}. Change the dates so each day has one set of hours.
pageHours.clearBody: Your page shows no hours and no open chip until you add some.
pageHours.clearNote: Closing for a holiday? Use Closed for a while instead, so your hours stay.
pageHours.tooMany: That many openings is more than a page can keep ({{count}}). Join days that share their hours.
pageHours.invalid: Some of these hours couldn't be saved. Check the times and dates.
pageHours.daysTakenNote: Dashed days already have hours. Picking one moves it here.
pageHours.openingsNote: For a lunch break, add a second opening. Times are 24-hour, like 10:00 or 17:30. A closing time before the opening runs past midnight.
pageHours.sameTimes: Opening and closing can’t be the same time.
pageHours.dayOfMonth: Pick a day that’s in that month.
pageHours.datesNote: These dates repeat every year. They can run over New Year, like Nov 1 – Feb 28.
pageHours.removeDates: Remove these dates and their hours
